tools.description: One accreditation cycle by reference (ACR/...) or title: each criterion with its evidence items (what is asked for, owner, due date, status, evidence attached), progress, the submission and the outcome. Read-only.

tools.name: list_regulatory_notices
tools.description: Notices and circulars from boards, the education department, the district, ministries, universities and courts: reference, source, title, status (new, under review, applicable, not applicable, actioned), whether verified genuine, and the actions that follow. Read-only.

tools.name: list_notice_sources
tools.description: The official web pages the school watches for new notices: name, address, body, when last checked and whether it changed or the check failed. Read-only.

tools.name: get_safeguarding_guidance
tools.description: Anyone: the statutory guidance on what to do about a child-protection concern, sexual harassment at work, ragging or a risk of self-harm (who must be told, emergency numbers 112, Childline 1098, Tele-MANAS 14416). General guidance only; no case is read or filed here: a concern is reported on the Safeguarding page. Read-only.

topic.description: Leave out for all of it

tools.name: add_standard_compliance_obligations
tools.description: For the compliance officer: load the suggested obligations for this kind of institution (POCSO, POSH, fire and building certificates, UDISE+ or AISHE, public disclosure, transport safety, DPDP consent ...) into the register. Each arrives "under review" for you to decide whether it applies; existing ones are left alone. Needs confirmation.

tools.name: update_compliance_obligation
tools.description: For the compliance officer: change an obligation's next due date, its owner (a member of staff by name), or switch it off or on. Whether it applies is recorded with record_obligation_applicability_decision. Needs confirmation.

owner.description: A member of staff by name, or "nobody"

tools.name: record_obligation_applicability_decision
tools.description: For the compliance officer: record whether an obligation applies to this school (applicable, not applicable, or back under review) with the reason in words. Recorded only when the officer states the decision in their own words. Confirmed on the website.

decision.description: the compliance officer's own decision, as they stated it. Never suggest or assume one.

note.description: Why it does or does not apply

tools.name: generate_regulatory_return
tools.description: For the compliance officer: generate a regulatory return as a draft from the school's records (UDISE+ profile, AISHE profile, monthly attendance for a YYYY-MM, staff strength, board candidate list for a class, mandatory disclosure, or a custom one), with every figure's source and the validation findings. Nothing is filed. Needs confirmation.

period.description: e.g. 2026-27, 2026-09 (monthly attendance), or the class for a candidate list

obligation.description: The obligation it answers, by code or title

tools.name: edit_regulatory_return_figures
tools.description: For the compliance officer: correct or enter figures on a draft return (a custom return's figures, or an adjustment), each as a field and value, with a note saying what changed and why; the change is logged on the return. Needs confirmation.

tools.name: move_regulatory_return
tools.description: For the compliance officer: move a return along: regenerate a draft from fresh records; send it for review (to a colleague who manages compliance, by name; validation errors must be acknowledged); record that it was submitted to the authority (method and the acknowledgement number you received — nothing is filed from here); record the authority's outcome (accepted, or rejected with what they said); or reopen a rejected one for resubmission. Confirmed on the website.

acknowledgeErrors.description: send_for_review: send it although it has validation errors

acknowledgementNo.description: record_submission: the portal acknowledgement or receipt number

response.description: record_outcome: what the authority said (required when rejected)

tools.name: record_return_review_decision
tools.description: For the reviewer of a regulatory return in review: send it back to the preparer (with a note saying what to fix) or pass it on for the principal's approval for submission. Recorded only when the reviewer states the decision in their own words; the preparer can never review their own return. Confirmed on the website.

decision.description: the reviewer's own decision, as they stated it. Never suggest or assume one.

tools.name: add_compliance_licence
tools.description: For the compliance officer: add a licence, certificate, recognition, affiliation, NOC, registration or insurance to the register with its number, issuer and dates; its status comes from the expiry date and a renewal reminder follows. Needs confirmation.

renewalLeadDays.description: Days before expiry to start renewing (default 60)

tools.name: update_compliance_licence
tools.description: For the compliance officer: update a licence or certificate: new dates after renewal (the old period stays in its history), renewal progress, number, issuer, cost, notes or public disclosure. Needs confirmation.

renewalLeadDays.description: Days before expiry to start renewing (default 60)

tools.name: create_compliance_policy
tools.description: For the compliance officer: create a school policy (code, title, category, who it is addressed to, whether they must acknowledge it, review interval) with its first version as a draft (summary and text). Sending it for approval is a separate step. Needs confirmation.

tools.name: draft_policy_version
tools.description: For the compliance officer: write the next version of a policy (or edit the draft already open): summary of what changed and the text. It stays a draft until sent for approval. Needs confirmation.

tools.name: send_policy_for_approval
tools.description: For the compliance officer: send a policy's draft version for approval, with the date it takes effect. The approver decides on the Approvals screen; once approved, everyone it is addressed to is asked to acknowledge it. Confirmed on the website.

effectiveFrom.description: Default the day it is approved

tools.name: update_training_attendance
tools.description: For the compliance officer, after a training has been held: mark who attended, was absent or exempt (by name, with an assessment score if there was one), a head count for a group, notes, and complete it (needs notes or evidence); or cancel a session that has not been completed. Confirmed on the website.

groupAttendance.description: Head count, for an audience without names (students, drivers)

tools.name: create_accreditation_cycle
tools.description: For the compliance officer: start an accreditation or inspection preparation cycle (NAAC, NBA, a board or university inspection, or custom) with a title, programme and target date. It starts with the framework's criteria headings, to be checked against the agency's current manual. Needs confirmation.

tools.name: add_accreditation_criterion
tools.description: For the compliance officer: add a criterion heading (code and title) to an accreditation cycle still being prepared. Needs confirmation.

tools.name: add_accreditation_item
tools.description: For the compliance officer: add an evidence item under a criterion of an accreditation cycle (what is asked for), with an owner from the staff by name (they are told), a due date and a note. Confirmed on the website.

tools.name: update_accreditation_item
tools.description: The owner of an accreditation evidence item (or the compliance officer): change its status (not started, in progress, ready — needs evidence attached on the page — or not applicable with a reason) and its note. The officer may also change what is asked for, the due date and the owner. Evidence files are attached on the Compliance page. Needs confirmation.

item.description: What the item asks for (its wording)

cycle.description: Reference or title, to narrow it down

owner.description: Officer only: a member of staff by name

tools.name: move_accreditation_cycle
tools.description: For the compliance officer: record that a cycle's criteria were checked against the agency's current manual; record that the school submitted to the agency (the reference you received; the system submits nothing; incomplete evidence must be acknowledged, and evidence is then locked); or record the agency's outcome after submission (closes the cycle). Confirmed on the website.

acknowledgeIncomplete.description: record_submission: record it although some evidence is not ready

tools.name: log_regulatory_notice
tools.description: For the compliance officer: record a notice or circular received from a board, the education department, the district, a ministry, a university or a court (title, their reference, link, dates, summary). It starts new and unverified, and the compliance officer and principal are told to review it. Confirmed on the website.

tools.name: update_regulatory_notice
tools.description: For the compliance officer: record whether a notice was verified as genuine (or looks suspect) and how; and, once it is recorded as applicable, add the actions that follow (title, owner from the staff by name — they are told — and due date) or mark actions done. Whether it applies is recorded with record_notice_applicability_decision. Confirmed on the website.

tools.name: record_notice_applicability_decision
tools.description: For the compliance officer: record whether a regulatory notice applies to this school, with the rationale. It must first be verified as genuine to be applicable. A notice changes no policy or obligation by itself; the actions that follow are added after. Recorded only when the officer states the decision in their own words. Confirmed on the website.

decision.description: the compliance officer's own decision, as they stated it. Never suggest or assume one.

tools.name: add_notice_source
tools.description: For the compliance officer: watch an official web page (https only) for new notices: its name, address, which body publishes it and the jurisdiction. A change creates a notice for review. Needs confirmation.

tools.name: check_notice_source
tools.description: For the compliance officer: check a watched page now. If it changed since the last check a new, unverified notice is created and the compliance officer and principal are told; a failed check is recorded as failed. Confirmed on the website.

tools.name: list_fee_academic_years
tools.description: The academic years the caller has fee records for (a family sees only their own children's years), newest first, with how many invoices each holds. Read-only.

tools.name: get_fee_year_statement
tools.description: One academic year's fees for the caller in one answer: totals billed, paid and outstanding, the published installment plans, the invoices and the settled payments. A family sees only their own children; the current year when none is named. Read-only.

tools.name: get_installment_plan_breakdown
tools.description: One installment / part-payment plan in full: each installment with its due date, invoice and what is paid, and who created, submitted, reviewed, approved or rejected it and when. Name the student (and the plan when they have several). A family sees only their own children's published plans. Read-only.

plan.description: The plan's name, when the student has more than one

tools.name: get_payment_audit_trail
tools.description: The full audit trail of one fee payment: who recorded it and in what role, who verified or rejected it and why, every change request and every audited change with before and after. Name it by receipt number or by the invoice it is on. Read-only.

tools.name: get_reminder_preview
tools.description: Who a fee reminder would reach, before anything is sent: the overdue students chosen by ageing bucket, class or minimum days overdue (families on a fee plan left out unless asked), with the amount and how many have no guardian to message. Sends nothing. Read-only.

className.description: e.g. "Class 8 B"

minDays.description: At least this many days overdue

includePlans.description: Include families on an approved fee plan

tools.name: list_seat_purchases
tools.description: This school's seat ledger, newest first: every purchase, approval and correction with the seats before and after, the amount and who made it. Read-only.

limit.description: Default 50

tools.name: list_seat_price_changes
tools.description: Every version of this school's per-seat price, newest first, including superseded and deactivated ones, so an old charge can be explained. Read-only.

limit.description: Default 50

tools.name: get_seat_request
tools.description: One of this school's extra-seat requests in full: seats, price and discount, amount, payment status and receipt, and the platform's decision. Name it by receipt number or by the number of seats asked for. Read-only.

seats.description: How many seats the request was for

tools.name: get_procurement_stats
tools.description: Purchasing at a glance: purchase requests waiting for approval, orders waiting for goods, invoices waiting for payment, and the approved budgets' planned, committed and spent totals with how many lines are over budget. Read-only.

tools.name: list_vendors
tools.description: The vendor register: name, category, GSTIN, contact, whether due diligence is done (active, pending or blocked) and the last four digits of the bank account. Declared conflicts are shown only to those who manage purchasing. Read-only.

vendor.description: Part of the name or category

tools.name: create_vendor
tools.description: For purchasing staff: add a vendor to the register (name, category, GSTIN, contact person, phone, email, address). It starts pending due diligence, so no purchase order can go to it until that is recorded. Bank details are entered on the Procurement page. Confirmed on the website.

tools.name: record_vendor_due_diligence
tools.description: Record the purchasing approver's own due-diligence decision on a vendor: CLEARED (the vendor becomes active and can receive purchase orders) or BLOCKED, with the note of what was checked. Recorded only when the approver states the decision in their own words; never suggested. Confirmed on the website.

decision.description: the approver's own decision, as they stated it. Never suggest or assume one.

note.description: What was checked (documents, references, site visit) and the finding

tools.name: declare_vendor_conflict
tools.description: For any member of staff: declare your own relationship with a vendor (a relative works there, you hold shares ...). You are then kept out of approving purchases from it. Needs confirmation.

tools.name: get_purchase_request
tools.description: One purchase request in full: items, quotes and the one selected, the pre-approval checks, the purchase order, goods received, invoices and their three-way match, payment stage and history. Staff see their own; purchasing sees all. Name it by PR reference or title. Read-only.

tools.name: set_purchase_quotes
tools.description: Attach the vendor quotes to a draft purchase request (vendor from the register, amount in rupees, valid-till date, a link to the quote) and mark the one to go with. Purchases of ₹50,000 or more need three quotes; choosing other than the lowest needs a note saying why. Replaces the quotes already on it. Confirmed on the website.

selectionNote.description: Why the selected quote, when it is not the lowest

tools.name: transition_purchase_request
tools.description: Send a draft purchase request of your own for approval (the quote, budget and split-purchase checks run first and travel with it to the approvers), or cancel a request with a reason (purchasing may cancel any; a committed amount is released from the budget). Approving stays with the approvers. Confirmed on the website.

tools.name: move_purchase_request
tools.description: For purchasing staff, the purchase-order steps after approval: issue_po (to the selected vendor; one not yet through due diligence needs an override and a reason), receive_goods (quantities received and rejected per item, or everything still due; never by the person who asked for it) or book_invoice (the vendor's invoice number, amount and date; it is matched against the order and the goods accepted). Approving and making the payment stay on the Procurement page. Confirmed on the website.

request.description: PR reference, PO number or title

overrideDueDiligence.description: issue_po: issue before the vendor's due diligence is done

item.description: The item as written on the request

lines.description: receive_goods: per item; leave out to receive everything still due

invoiceUrl.description: book_invoice: https link to the invoice

tools.name: list_procurement_assets
tools.description: The asset register: tag, description, cost, date acquired, vendor, status (in use, in store, under repair, disposed) and warranty. Read-only.

search.description: Tag or part of the description

tools.name: update_procurement_asset
tools.description: For purchasing staff: change an asset in the register — its status (in use, in store, under repair, disposed), the room or place it is in, the member of staff responsible for it, or its warranty end date. Name it by tag (e.g. "AST-00012") or description. Confirmed on the website.

custodian.description: The staff member responsible, by name

tools.name: submit_budget
tools.description: Send a draft budget for approval: it goes to the approvals inbox with every line and its planned amount. The approvers decide; nothing is committed until they do. Confirmed on the website.

tools.name: add_budget_variance_note
tools.description: Write the explanation for a budget line that is over or under plan (why the spend differs), so it travels with the budget report. Name the budget and the line by code or head. Needs confirmation.

tools.name: list_funding_proposals
tools.description: Funding proposals (loans, grants, donations, CSR, government schemes, internal reserves): amount asked, the offers compared by EMI and total cost, the status, and what has been disbursed and used. Read-only.

tools.name: create_funding_proposal
tools.description: Draft a funding proposal: the kind (loan, grant, donation, CSR, government scheme, internal reserve), title, purpose, amount needed in rupees, whether it is restricted, and the offers to compare (provider, principal, annual interest %, tenure in months, processing fee, covenants; mark the preferred one). EMI and total cost are worked out. It stays a draft until submitted. Confirmed on the website.

tools.name: transition_funding_proposal
tools.description: Move a funding proposal along: submit a draft for approval (the offers go to the approvers compared by total cost), or, once approved, mark it applied, sanctioned or closed, with a note. Approving stays with the approvers; recording money disbursed or used stays on the Budgets page. Confirmed on the website.

tools.name: list_service_accounts
tools.description: The recurring services the school pays for (electricity, water, internet, AMCs, rent, insurance ...): vendor, account number, billing cycle, expected amount, next due date, contract end and notice date, bills on record, last amount and what is outstanding. Read-only.

tools.name: create_service_account
tools.description: Add a recurring service the school pays for: its name, category, vendor, account number, billing cycle, expected amount, next due date, contract dates and notice, and AMC visits a year (with the first visit date). Its expected-bill and visit reminders join the task queue. Needs confirmation.

noticeDays.description: Notice to give before the contract ends

tools.name: update_service_account
tools.description: Change a recurring service: vendor, account number, cycle, expected amount, next due date, contract dates and notice, AMC visits, notes, or pause / end it. Name it in words ("electricity", "lift AMC"). Its reminders follow. Needs confirmation.

noticeDays.description: Notice to give before the contract ends

tools.name: sync_bill_reminders
tools.description: Bring every bill, expected-bill, service-visit and renewal reminder in the task queue up to date now (the same as the scheduled run): owners see the tasks that are due. Confirmed on the website.

tools.name: get_service_bill
tools.description: One bill in full: the service and account, bill number and date, amount, due date, payments recorded and confirmed, status and its history. Name it by reference ("BIL-000042"), the provider's bill number, or the service. Read-only.

tools.name: create_concession_scheme
tools.description: Add a fee concession scheme the school offers (sibling, staff ward, merit, RTE, need-based, sports ...): a short code, name, how it is worked out (a percentage, a fixed amount, or decided per case), the fee heads it applies to and who is eligible. Individual concessions are then requested against it and approved. Confirmed on the website.

method.description: PERCENT of the fee, a FIXED amount, or decided per case

feeHeads.description: The fee heads it applies to, by name

tools.name: update_concession_scheme
tools.description: Change a fee concession scheme: its name, how it is worked out, the percentage or amount, the fee heads, eligibility, or switch it off / on. Concessions already applied are not changed. Confirmed on the website.

method.description: PERCENT of the fee, a FIXED amount, or decided per case

feeHeads.description: The fee heads it applies to, by name

tools.name: get_invoice_concession_history
tools.description: One invoice as the concessions screen shows it: its lines with fee heads, every concession, credit note and void on it, what is outstanding, what is already reserved by pending requests and how much can still be adjusted. Read-only.

tools.name: get_voucher_summary
tools.description: The accounting vouchers fee receipts, refunds and adjustments make for a period, summarised for the accountant: count and amount by voucher type, the ledgers used and the first vouchers as a sample. The Tally XML / CSV files are downloaded on the Accounts export page. Read-only.

tools.name: list_gst_rates
tools.description: Each fee head with its GST rate and HSN/SAC code (or none), as used on invoices and the GST summary. Read-only.

tools.name: set_fee_head_tax
tools.description: Set the GST rate (0 for none) and the HSN/SAC code of a fee head; invoices raised from then on carry it. Needs both accounts export and fee structure permission. Confirmed on the website.

tools.name: list_cash_closes
tools.description: The cash counter's closed days, newest first: cash counted against expected, the variance, receipts, deposit slip, who closed it and whether a second person has checked the count. Read-only.

limit.description: Days, default 31

tools.name: get_scenario_baseline
tools.description: The starting point for what-if planning: students by grade, teachers and other staff, transport riders and vehicles, fee per student, concession and collection rates and the budget, with every default assumption and where it comes from (records or a stated default). Read-only.

tools.name: get_scenario_projection
tools.description: A what-if projection 1 to 5 years ahead from the current records, with any assumptions changed (intake, retention, fee increase, concessions, collection, staff ratio and cost, transport, other costs). Year by year: students, fee income, teachers and vehicles needed, costs and surplus. Saves nothing. Read-only.

intake.description: New students each year into the first grade

tools.name: get_scenario_comparison
tools.description: Two to four saved scenarios side by side over the same current records: their assumptions and year-by-year results. Read-only.

tools.name: list_budget_scenarios
tools.description: The saved what-if scenarios: name, description, years ahead, who made it, when it was changed and how many assumptions it edits. Read-only.

tools.name: get_scenario
tools.description: One saved scenario with its assumptions and its year-by-year projection over the current records. Read-only.

tools.name: create_scenario
tools.description: Save a what-if scenario for leadership: a name, a description, how many years ahead (1 to 5) and the assumptions changed from the defaults. Needs confirmation.

intake.description: New students each year into the first grade

tools.name: update_scenario
tools.description: Change a saved scenario: rename it, its description, the years ahead, or its assumptions (the ones given replace the edited set). Needs confirmation.

intake.description: New students each year into the first grade

tools.name: archive_scenario
tools.description: Remove a saved scenario from the list (it is archived, not erased). Needs confirmation.

tools.name: create_lab
tools.description: For administration: set up a laboratory profile for a lab room in the facilities register (one that has none yet), with its type (chemistry, physics, biology, composite science or computer), capacity, alert window and safety checklist. Needs confirmation.

room.description: The lab room by name or code, as in the facilities register

alertDays.description: How many days ahead expiring stock is flagged (default 60)

safetyChecklist.description: Checks ticked before every practical, e.g. "Goggles on"

tools.name: list_lab_rooms_without_profile
tools.description: For administration: lab rooms in the facilities register that do not have a laboratory profile yet (code, name, capacity), to set one up. Read-only.

tools.name: search_lab_code
tools.description: What a lab label names: a batch code, lot number, instrument code or serial, or computer tag typed in when the label will not scan, within the labs the caller may see. Read-only.

tools.name: sync_lab_due_items
tools.description: For administration: bring every lab reminder in the tasks queue up to date now (batch expiries, calibrations, warranty and AMC ends, software renewals, items below minimum stock), as the daily job does. Needs confirmation.

tools.name: update_lab_item
tools.description: Change a lab stock item's details: its name, minimum stock and reorder quantity (in the item's unit), shelf location, storage group, hazard classes, locked-cupboard flag, CAS number, estimated unit price, or retire it. Needs confirmation.

item.description: The item as people call it, e.g. "beaker 250 mL" or "hydrochloric acid"

labName.description: Which lab, when more than one holds it

tools.name: return_lab_stock
tools.description: Bring issued lab stock back to its batch (never more than is still out on that issue), e.g. "2 beakers came back from the 9A practical". Needs confirmation.

item.description: The item as people call it, e.g. "beaker 250 mL" or "hydrochloric acid"

labName.description: Which lab, when more than one holds it

issuedTo.description: Who or what it was issued to, when there are several issues out

tools.name: set_lab_batch_status
tools.description: Quarantine a lab stock batch (with the reason; it can then not be issued) or release it back to use (never an expired one), and/or record when it was opened or where it is kept. The batch is named by its code. Needs confirmation.

batch.description: Batch code, e.g. "LB-000012", or the lot number

tools.name: list_lab_stock_movements
tools.description: The lab stock ledger, newest first: receipts, issues (with what is still out), returns, consumption, damage, disposal and stocktake adjustments; optionally one lab, one item or one kind. Read-only.

tools.name: update_lab_equipment
tools.description: Change a lab instrument's record: name, serial, make, quantity, condition, calibration need and interval, calibration due date, warranty and AMC dates and vendor; take it out of service (with the reason) or put it back; or record it as disposed of (with the reason). Calibration certificates use record_lab_calibration. Needs confirmation.

tools.name: record_lab_equipment_repair
tools.description: Log a repair on a lab instrument (OPEN: what is wrong, the vendor, an estimate, optionally a maintenance work order; it goes out of service unless told otherwise) or close one (CLOSE: what was done, the cost; it is back in service once no repair is open). Needs confirmation.

issue.description: OPEN: what is wrong; CLOSE: which repair, when several are open

action.description: What was or will be done

createWorkOrder.description: OPEN: raise a maintenance work order too

keepInService.description: OPEN: it can still be used meanwhile

stayOutOfService.description: CLOSE: keep it out of service

tools.name: list_lab_devices
tools.description: Lab computers and other devices: tag, workstation, kind, status (in use, spare, in repair), the software with a seat on each, open repairs and warranty. Optionally one lab or one status. Read-only.

tools.name: update_lab_device
tools.description: Change a lab computer's record: tag, workstation number, kind, make, operating system, serial, status (in use, spare, in repair), warranty and AMC dates, CPU, RAM and storage. No passwords or licence keys are stored. Needs confirmation.

tools.name: record_lab_device_repair
tools.description: Log a repair on a lab computer or device (OPEN: what is wrong, vendor, estimate, optionally a work order; it is marked in repair) or close one (CLOSE: what was done, the cost, and whether it goes back in use or to spares). Needs confirmation.

issue.description: OPEN: what is wrong; CLOSE: which repair, when several are open

backTo.description: CLOSE: where it goes (default in use)

tools.name: list_lab_software
tools.description: Lab software and licence seats: version, licence type, seats used and free, renewal date. Optionally one lab. No licence keys are kept. Read-only.

tools.name: add_lab_software
tools.description: Add a software title to a lab (or, for administration, school-wide): publisher, version, licence type, number of seats, renewal date, cost and vendor. Never a licence key or password. Needs confirmation.

labName.description: Required unless it is school-wide (administration only)

tools.name: update_lab_software
tools.description: Change a lab software record: name, publisher, version, licence type, seats (not below those in use), renewal date (a new date records a renewal), cost, vendor, notes, or retire it. Needs confirmation.

tools.name: set_lab_software_seat
tools.description: Give a lab computer a seat of a software title (ASSIGN; refused when every seat is in use) or free its seat (RELEASE). Needs confirmation.

tools.name: get_practical_session
tools.description: One practical session in full: lab, class, time, status, the stock and instruments it needs, the last readiness check and its problems, the safety checklist, attendance count and outcome. Read-only.

tools.name: update_practical_session
tools.description: Change a practical before it is prepared: its title, safety notes, computers needed, and the stock items and instruments it needs from the lab's own catalogue (each by name with a quantity). The readiness check is reset. Needs confirmation.

tools.name: move_practical_session
tools.description: Move a practical along: CHECK_READINESS (checks stock, instruments and computers as they are now), REQUEST_PREP (sends it to the lab assistant with a note), MARK_PREPARED (only when ready, or with acceptProblems and a note), START (only once the teacher says which safety checks are done; the class roll is loaded), COMPLETE (with an outcome note) or CANCEL (with the reason). Needs confirmation.

acceptProblems.description: MARK_PREPARED: go ahead despite readiness problems

checksDone.description: START: the safety checks the teacher says are done

allChecksDone.description: START: the teacher says every safety check is done

tools.service: labs.sessions.checkReadiness / requestPreparation / markPrepared / startSession / completeSession / cancelSession

tools.name: record_practical_attendance
tools.description: Supervised attendance for a practical that has started: who was in the lab (allPresent, or name those present, or those absent), plus anyone not on the class roll. Recorded by the supervising teacher. Needs confirmation.

extra.description: People in the lab who are not on the roll

tools.name: close_lab_incident
tools.description: Close an open lab incident with what was done about it. Needs confirmation.

incident.description: Reference, e.g. "LIN/2026/0002", or the lab name when it has one open incident

tools.name: get_lab
tools.description: One laboratory's profile: type, room, capacity, who is in charge, the lab assistant, the alert window, the safety checklist and notes. Read-only.

tools.name: update_lab
tools.description: Change a laboratory's profile: name, type, capacity, alert window, notes, safety checklist and lab assistant; administration can also change who is in charge and close or reopen it. Needs confirmation.

tools.name: add_lab_item
tools.description: Add an item to a lab's stock catalogue (a chemical, consumable, glassware, specimen or component): its unit, CAS number, hazard classes, storage group, minimum stock, reorder quantity, location and locked-cupboard flag. Stock itself is then received with receive_lab_stock. Needs confirmation.

unit.description: g, kg, mg, mL, L or pcs

tools.name: record_lab_stocktake
tools.description: Record a lab stocktake: what was counted on the shelf, batch by batch (each by its code), with the reason. Each difference becomes an adjustment in the ledger; a batch that moved since it was counted is refused and must be recounted. Needs confirmation.

tools.name: add_lab_equipment
tools.description: Add an instrument to a lab: name, serial, make, quantity, condition, whether it needs calibration and how often, the last calibration or the next due date, warranty and AMC. Needs confirmation.

tools.name: add_lab_devices
tools.description: Register computers or other devices in a lab, each by its asset tag, with workstation number, kind, make, operating system and serial. A tag already registered is refused. Needs confirmation.

tools.name: get_lab_fefo_plan
tools.description: Which batches to take a quantity of a lab item from, first-expiry-first-out, and how much is short; expired and quarantined stock is never in the plan. Read-only.

item.description: The item as people call it, e.g. "beaker 250 mL" or "hydrochloric acid"

labName.description: Which lab, when more than one holds it

on.description: For a practical on this date (default today)

tools.name: add_vehicle
tools.description: For the transport office: register a school vehicle with its registration number, type, lawful capacity and usable seats, ownership or contractor, papers and their expiry dates, safety-check and service dates and the usual driver. Each due date goes into the tasks queue. Needs confirmation.

documents.description: Permit, insurance, fitness, PUC, RC with their expiry dates

tools.name: get_vehicle
tools.description: One school vehicle in full: status, seats, papers and their expiry, safety checks, service due, the usual driver, its live-location state, open breakdowns and recent fuel, service and check entries. For the transport office and the principal. Read-only.

tools.name: update_vehicle
tools.description: Change a school vehicle's record: type, make, seats (never above the lawful capacity), ownership and contractor, odometer, safety-check and service dates, the usual driver, and add renewed papers (a renewed permit, insurance, fitness or PUC with its new expiry; older entries are kept). Needs confirmation.

documents.description: Permit, insurance, fitness, PUC, RC with their expiry dates

tools.name: set_vehicle_status
tools.description: Put a school vehicle in service (ACTIVE), send it for servicing (IN_SERVICE), mark it broken down (BREAKDOWN) or retire it (RETIRED, final), with a note. A vehicle that is not active cannot be put on a trip. Needs confirmation.

tools.name: resolve_vehicle_breakdown
tools.description: Close a vehicle's open breakdown with what was done; a broken-down vehicle goes back to active. Needs confirmation.

on.description: The breakdown date, when there are several open

tools.name: set_vehicle_gps_device
tools.description: Link a registered GPS tracker to a vehicle (one tracker per vehicle), or unlink it. The tracker itself is registered on the Safety devices screen. Needs confirmation.

unlink.description: Remove the tracker from this vehicle

tools.name: get_vehicle_track
tools.description: Where a school vehicle has been over the last minutes (default 120, up to a day) from its GPS tracker: how many fixes, the first and last, the last position and top speed. For the transport office and the principal; the map is on the Fleet screen. Read-only.

tools.name: get_fleet_fuel_summary
tools.description: Fuel used and spent per vehicle over a period (default the last 30 days): litres, rupees, entries and km per litre where two odometer readings allow it. Read-only.

tools.name: plan_bus_trip
tools.description: For the transport office: plan one trip — a route's morning pickup or afternoon drop, or an event trip — on a date with a roadworthy vehicle, start time, driver and attendant (the crew's clearance is checked). Seats are then allocated. Needs confirmation.

route.description: The route by name (needed for pickup and drop)

eventName.description: What the event trip is called (needed for an event trip)

tools.name: plan_bus_trips_for_day
tools.description: For the transport office: plan a day's morning pickup and afternoon drop for every active route that has a registered vehicle, and seat the students enrolled on each (existing trips are left alone; routes without a vehicle are listed). Confirmed on the website.

attendantName.description: An attendant for every trip, if one

tools.name: get_bus_trip
tools.description: One bus trip in full: vehicle and its live-location state, crew, planned stops and arrivals, the next stop and its estimated time, every seat (who boarded, got off, was handed over or did not show) and the trip's alerts. A teacher on bus duty sees only their own trips. Read-only.

trip.description: Reference (e.g. "TRIP/2026/0012") or the trip named in words, e.g. "Route 4 morning pickup"

tools.name: set_trip_crew
tools.description: For the transport office: put a driver and/or attendant on a trip (a member of staff by name, or a contracted person's name and phone). Uncleared crew are refused or flagged as the school's policy says. Needs confirmation.

trip.description: Reference (e.g. "TRIP/2026/0012") or the trip named in words, e.g. "Route 4 morning pickup"

tools.name: substitute_trip_vehicle
tools.description: For the transport office: put a different roadworthy vehicle on a trip, with the reason; refused unless its usable seats cover everyone already allocated. Needs confirmation.

trip.description: Reference (e.g. "TRIP/2026/0012") or the trip named in words, e.g. "Route 4 morning pickup"

tools.name: cancel_bus_trip
tools.description: For the transport office: cancel a planned or running trip with the reason. The families of every student with a seat are messaged. Confirmed on the website.

trip.description: Reference (e.g. "TRIP/2026/0012") or the trip named in words, e.g. "Route 4 morning pickup"

tools.name: manage_trip_seat
tools.description: Give a student a seat on a trip, optionally at a stop (ALLOCATE; refused when the trip is full), or free a seat that was not used (RELEASE). A teacher on bus duty acts only on their own trips. Confirmed on the website.

trip.description: Reference (e.g. "TRIP/2026/0012") or the trip named in words, e.g. "Route 4 morning pickup"

studentId.description: Preferred when known, e.g. from search_students

studentName.description: Full or partial name; an ambiguous match is refused, never guessed

tools.name: allocate_enrolled_to_trip
tools.description: Seat every student enrolled on a trip's route for its direction, until the trip is full (those left over are listed). Confirmed on the website.

trip.description: Reference (e.g. "TRIP/2026/0012") or the trip named in words, e.g. "Route 4 morning pickup"

tools.name: move_bus_trip
tools.description: Move a bus trip along: START (the vehicle is checked as roadworthy again), RECONCILE (enrolled vs allocated vs boarded vs got off vs handed over; anyone not accounted for raises an alert) or COMPLETE (reconciles first; with anyone unaccounted for a note of what was done is required). A teacher on bus duty acts only on their own trips. Confirmed on the website.

trip.description: Reference (e.g. "TRIP/2026/0012") or the trip named in words, e.g. "Route 4 morning pickup"

note.description: COMPLETE: what was done about anyone unaccounted for

tools.name: mark_trip_stop
tools.description: Record that the bus arrived at or left a stop on a trip the caller runs (for when the GPS does not). Needs confirmation.

trip.description: Reference (e.g. "TRIP/2026/0012") or the trip named in words, e.g. "Route 4 morning pickup"

tools.name: record_trip_handover
tools.description: At a drop stop: hand a student over to an authorised adult (a guardian with pickup authority or an in-date delegate on the child's list, named, with how they were verified), or, when nobody authorised is there, record that the child is going back to school with the bus (guardians are told and the transport office alerted). Never to anyone else. Confirmed on the website.

trip.description: Reference (e.g. "TRIP/2026/0012") or the trip named in words, e.g. "Route 4 morning pickup"

returnToSchool.description: Nobody authorised is at the stop

tools.name: suppress_trip_alerts
tools.description: Pause the delay and GPS alerts of a trip for some minutes (5 to 240, default 30), with the reason, e.g. a known road closure. Needs confirmation.

trip.description: Reference (e.g. "TRIP/2026/0012") or the trip named in words, e.g. "Route 4 morning pickup"

tools.name: get_checkpoint_attendance_suggestions
tools.description: Where today's (or a day's) gate and bus scans disagree with the class register: scanned in but not marked, marked absent but scanned in, or marked present with no scan; optionally one class. Suggestions only: the register is the record and is never changed from scans. Read-only.

className.description: e.g. "Class 6 A"

tools.name: list_id_cards
tools.description: Student and staff ID cards: holder, code, QR or RFID, and status (active, lost, revoked, replaced); optionally by status or a holder's name. Read-only.

tools.name: issue_id_card
tools.description: Issue an ID card (QR or RFID) to a student or a member of staff who has no active card; a code is generated unless the printed one is given. Confirmed on the website.

studentName.description: The student as people name them, e.g. "Rahul Sharma"

code.description: The code on a pre-printed card, if any

tools.name: get_id_card_log
tools.description: An ID card's history: the chain of cards it replaced and its last 100 checkpoint scans (where and when it was presented; not proof of where the holder is). Read-only.

tools.name: issue_replacement_id_card
tools.description: Replace a student's or staff member's ID card (lost, damaged, revoked) with a new one, with the reason; the old card stops working. Confirmed on the website.

newCode.description: The code on a pre-printed replacement, if any

tools.name: list_my_hosted_visitors
tools.description: For any member of staff: the visitors coming to see them — waiting for their approval, approved and expected, or on site now. Read-only.

tools.name: record_visitor_host_decision
tools.description: For the member of staff a visitor is coming to see (or the front office recording what the host said): record the host's own decision — APPROVED or REJECTED — on a visit waiting for them. Recorded only when the host states it in their own words; never suggested. Confirmed on the website.

decision.description: the host's own decision, as they stated it. Never suggest or assume one.

note.description: The front office must say how the host gave the decision

tools.name: list_student_pickup_adults
tools.description: For the front office: who may collect a student — the guardians (and whether each may collect), standing authorised adults and in-date delegates — and whether a custody restriction is on file (its details are on the Gate screen). Read-only.

studentName.description: The student as people name them, e.g. "Rahul Sharma"

tools.name: add_student_pickup_adult
tools.description: For the front office: add an adult who may collect a student — a standing AUTHORISED adult, or a DELEGATE for a limited time (an end date is required, within the school's maximum). Custody restrictions are recorded on the Gate screen, not here. Confirmed on the website.

studentName.description: The student as people name them, e.g. "Rahul Sharma"

tools.name: revoke_pickup_adult
tools.description: For the front office: end an authorised adult's or delegate's permission to collect a student. Lifting a custody restriction is done on the Gate screen. Confirmed on the website.

studentName.description: The student as people name them, e.g. "Rahul Sharma"

tools.name: record_pickup_release
tools.description: At the gate (or the hostel): record a student being released to an adult on their pickup list — a guardian with pickup authority or an in-date authorised adult or delegate — and how they were verified. Anyone else is refused; a custody-restricted adult is stopped and the office alerted. Confirmed on the website.

studentName.description: The student as people name them, e.g. "Rahul Sharma"

tools.name: list_gate_releases
tools.description: The gate and bus release log: which student went with whom, when, where (gate, hostel, bus drop) and how the adult was verified; for a day and/or one student. Read-only.

studentName.description: The student as people name them, e.g. "Rahul Sharma"

tools.name: get_outpass_record
tools.description: For the warden and the principal: one hostel out-pass in full — the resident, leaving and return times, destination, reason, escort, the guardian's and the warden's decisions, gate exit and return, and whether it is overdue. Families see theirs with list_my_outpasses. Read-only.

tools.name: request_outpass_for_resident
tools.description: For the warden: raise an out-pass on a resident's behalf (e.g. a guardian asked by phone): leaving and return date and time, destination, reason, escort. It goes to the warden queue for a decision. Confirmed on the website.

studentName.description: The resident

tools.name: cancel_resident_outpass
tools.description: For the warden: cancel a resident's out-pass that has not been used yet, with a note. Confirmed on the website.

tools.name: list_my_class_check_ins
tools.description: For a teacher: the classes they checked in to on a day (default today), by period, room and whether it was cover. Read-only.

tools.name: get_class_presence_board
tools.description: For the principal and administration: teacher presence by period on a day (default today), from the timetable and teachers' class check-ins: present, present on cover, not checked in yet, upcoming. "Not checked in" means no record yet, not that a class was unattended. Read-only.

tools.name: check_in_to_class
tools.description: For a teacher: check in to the class they are timetabled for (or covering) in a period today. Needs confirmation.

className.description: When more than one class meets in that period

tools.name: get_safety_settings
tools.description: The school's safety thresholds the caller manages: bus delay, arrival radius, GPS stale and offline minutes, alert repeat, uncleared-crew policy; checkpoint duplicate window and unauthorised-departure flag; visitor badge hours, overstay grace and delegate maximum days; out-pass late grace. Read-only.

tools.name: update_safety_settings
tools.description: Change the school's safety thresholds, section by section (each needs its own manage permission): fleet (delay, arrival radius, off-route, GPS stale/offline minutes, alert repeat, default speed, uncleared-crew policy WARN or BLOCK), checkpoints (duplicate window, flag unauthorised departure), visitors (badge hours, overstay grace, delegate maximum days), out-pass (late grace minutes). Confirmed on the website.

tools.name: list_safety_alerts
tools.description: Open (or acknowledged, resolved, all) safety alerts in the departments the caller looks after — transport (delays, GPS, wrong vehicle, unaccounted students, capacity, uncleared crew), gate and safety (custody stops, overstays), hostel (late returns): kind, severity, message, how often and when last seen. Read-only.

tools.name: update_safety_alert
tools.description: Acknowledge a safety alert (someone is on it) or resolve it with a note of what was done. The alert is named by words of its message or its kind. Needs confirmation.

alert.description: Words from the alert, e.g. "Route 4 delay" or "wrong vehicle Rahul"

tools.name: list_safety_devices
tools.description: Registered GPS trackers and card readers the caller manages: label, kind, status, the vehicle or checkpoint each serves, last seen and when its secret was last rotated (never the secret). Camera devices are on the Camera screen. Read-only.

tools.name: set_safety_device_status
tools.description: Disable a GPS tracker or card reader (its readings are then refused, e.g. when lost) or enable it again, with a note. Camera devices are managed on the Camera screen. Needs confirmation.

tools.name: get_library_rules
tools.description: The library desk rules: how many days a renewal adds, how many renewals a loan may have, how long a reserved book waits on the hold shelf, and the fine per day late. Read-only.

tools.name: list_library_shelf_categories
tools.description: What the library catalogue can be filtered by: its categories, authors, resource types, languages and exam types. Read-only.

tools.name: list_my_reading_challenges
tools.description: For a student: the reading challenges they are taking part in, with how many books they have read towards each and whether they have completed it. Read-only.

tools.name: close_reading_challenge
tools.description: For the librarian: close an active reading challenge (it stops counting books). Needs confirmation.

tools.name: get_hostel_incident
tools.description: One hostel incident in full: residents involved, category, severity, when and where, what happened and what was done, each contact with the family, and how it was resolved. Read-only.

tools.name: get_hostel_room
tools.description: One hostel room: block, floor, type, capacity, status, amenities and who lives there now. Read-only.

tools.name: get_club_options
tools.description: The choices the clubs screens offer: classes (grades) a club can be open to, bookable venues, club categories and activities, and (for administration) the staff who can be put in charge. Read-only.

tools.name: list_club_join_requests
tools.description: For a teacher in charge of a club (every club for administration): the requests to join that wait for a decision or for a parent's consent, oldest first, with the student's class. Read-only.

tools.name: get_club_portfolio
tools.description: A student's participation portfolio: clubs and teams they were in and for how long, sessions attended, fixtures with an approved result and their awards, approved co-curricular records and published showcase honours. A student sees their own, a parent their own child's, school-wide staff anyone's. Read-only.

studentName.description: Full or partial name; an ambiguous match is refused, never guessed

tools.name: record_club_join_decision
tools.description: For the teacher in charge of a club (any club for administration): record their decision on a student's request to join — approve (a seat, or the waiting list when the club is full) or decline with a reason. A request still waiting for a parent's consent cannot be approved. Recorded only when the teacher states the decision in their own words. Confirmed on the website.

studentName.description: The student who asked to join

decision.description: the teacher in charge's own decision, as they stated it. Never suggest or assume one.

tools.name: set_club_member_role
tools.description: For the teacher in charge of a club: make a current member captain or vice-captain, or an ordinary member again. Needs confirmation.

tools.name: remove_club_member
tools.description: For the teacher in charge of a club (any club for administration): take a student out of the club, or close their pending request or waiting-list place, with a reason. A freed seat goes to the head of the waiting list. Families withdraw their own child with withdraw_club_membership. Needs confirmation.

tools.name: list_houses
tools.description: The school's houses: colour, motto, house masters, how many students are in each (and, for staff, the captain; for a family, which house their child is in). Read-only.

tools.name: create_house
tools.description: For administration or the principal: set up a house with its colour, motto and house masters (members of staff by name). Needs confirmation.

tools.name: assign_students_to_house
tools.description: For administration or the principal: put students in a house (moving them from any other house), by admission number or name, and optionally name the house captain. Needs confirmation.

captain.description: Admission number or name of the house captain (must be in the house)

tools.name: get_house_points
tools.description: The house points table: points from inter-house results a second teacher has approved (results waiting for approval are not counted), with firsts and events, optionally for a date range. Read-only.

tools.name: list_club_fixtures
tools.description: Fixtures: inter-house events, matches inside the school and events against other schools, newest first, with venue, team-sheet size and result. Families see approved results only and only their own children named. Read-only.

tools.name: set_fixture_team_sheet
tools.description: For the teacher running a fixture: set its team sheet. A club fixture picks from the club's current members by name; an inter-house fixture takes students of the houses taking part (name or admission number). Replaces the earlier sheet; final once the result is approved. Needs confirmation.

tools.name: record_fixture_result_decision
tools.description: For a second teacher (the club's coach, a house master for an inter-house fixture, or administration): record their decision on a fixture result another teacher recorded — approve it (it then counts towards house points, portfolios and the showcase) or reject it with a reason. The teacher who recorded a result never approves it. Recorded only when the approver states the decision in their own words. Confirmed on the website.

decision.description: the approver's own decision, as they stated it. Never suggest or assume one.

tools.name: list_club_equipment
tools.description: For the teacher in charge of a club (all kit for administration): sports and arts kit with how many are in stock and how many are lent out. Read-only.

tools.name: add_club_equipment
tools.description: For the teacher in charge of a club: add kit to the club's store (bats, balls, costumes, instruments) with the quantity. Shared kit (no club) is added by administration only. Needs confirmation.

club.description: The club it belongs to; leave out for shared kit (administration only)

tools.name: list_club_equipment_loans
tools.description: For the teacher in charge of a club (all for administration): kit lent to students — who has what, since when, the return date, and which are overdue, returned or lost. Read-only.

tools.name: lend_club_equipment
tools.description: For the teacher in charge of a club: lend kit to a student (club kit goes to the club's current members), optionally with a return date — it then becomes a task until it comes back. Needs confirmation.

item.description: The kit, by name or code

tools.name: return_club_equipment
tools.description: For the teacher in charge of a club: record lent kit as back (in good or damaged condition) or written off as lost. Lost kit leaves the stock. Needs confirmation.

tools.name: get_club
tools.description: One club: who runs it, when and where it meets, seats and waiting list, its recent and coming sessions. Its coaches and school-wide staff also see the members and pending requests; a family sees only their own children's place in it. Read-only.

tools.name: update_club
tools.description: For the teacher in charge of a club: change how it runs — name, description, when it meets, home venue, capacity (never below the current members; a larger capacity seats the waiting list), whether it takes requests, an outside coach. Administration also changes who is in charge, its category and archives or reopens it. Needs confirmation.

teachersInCharge.description: Administration only: the staff in charge, by name

tools.name: get_showcase_settings
tools.description: The showcase's rank cut-off: only ranks 1 to this number are ever drawn, published or shown. Read-only.

tools.name: update_showcase_rank_cutoff
tools.description: For showcase publishers (never students or families): change the school's rank cut-off — the lowest rank (1 to 10) ever drawn, published or shown. Entries below a lowered cut-off are left out at the next publish. Confirmed on the website.

tools.name: get_showcase_options
tools.description: For showcase publishers: the exams with published marks, the classes and grades ranks can be drawn for, and the rank cut-off. Read-only.

tools.name: get_showcase_rank_preview
tools.description: For showcase publishers: the top ranks (up to the school's cut-off only, never a full list) of a published exam in a class or a grade, with each child's media consent. Read-only.

className.description: A class, e.g. "Class 6 A"

tools.name: list_showcase_candidates
tools.description: For showcase publishers: achievements worth showing — approved co-curricular records with an achievement and awards in fixture results a second teacher approved, over the last year (or the days given), with each child's media consent. Read-only.

tools.name: list_showcase_editions
tools.description: For showcase publishers: every showcase edition with its status and how many entries are drafted, reviewed, published, left out or withdrawn. Read-only.

tools.name: create_showcase_edition
tools.description: For showcase publishers (never students or families): start a new showcase edition (e.g. "Term 1 achievers"). It starts as a draft; nothing is shown until it is published. Needs confirmation.

tools.name: get_showcase_edition
tools.description: For showcase publishers: one edition with every entry — student, achievement or rank, status, who drafted and reviewed it, consent, and why an entry was left out. Read-only.

tools.name: draft_showcase_rank_entries
tools.description: For showcase publishers: draft the top ranks (up to the cut-off) of a published exam in a class or grade as entries of an edition. They stay drafts until someone else reviews them; consent is checked again when publishing. Needs confirmation.

tools.name: release_showcase_edition
tools.description: For showcase publishers, at their explicit request: make an edition's reviewed entries visible to the school. Each entry is checked again now — the child's media consent, the cut-off and (for ranks) the published results — and any that fails is left out with the reason. Drafts nobody reviewed stay drafts. Confirmed on the website.

tools.name: withdraw_showcase_edition
tools.description: For showcase publishers: take a published edition down, with a reason; all its entries stop being shown at once. Confirmed on the website.

tools.name: record_showcase_entry_review
tools.description: For a showcase publisher reviewing someone else's draft: record their review — approve it for publishing, or return it to draft with a note. The person who drafted an entry never reviews it. Recorded only when the reviewer states the decision in their own words. Confirmed on the website.

entry.description: The student's name or the entry title

decision.description: the reviewer's own decision, as they stated it. Never suggest or assume one.

tools.name: remove_showcase_entry
tools.description: For showcase publishers: take a published entry down with a reason (a consent withdrawn, a mistake), or delete an entry that was never published. Needs confirmation; a published entry's withdrawal is confirmed on the website.

entry.description: The student's name or the entry title

reason.description: Required to withdraw a published entry

tools.name: get_sustainability_overview
tools.description: For staff: the sustainability figures for a period (default this academic year) — waste by stream and segregation, trees planted and surviving, water and electricity per student, solar and rainwater — with activities waiting for verification and open sanitation tasks. Read-only.

tools.name: get_sustainability_map
tools.description: For staff: sustainability by campus zone — plants and survival, sanitation duties and open or overdue sanitation tasks — with the latest waste records and verified activities. No pupil names. Read-only.

tools.name: list_sustainability_zones
tools.description: For staff: the campus zones used for plants, waste, compost and sanitation (gardens, grounds, toilet blocks, tanks...). Read-only.

tools.name: add_sustainability_zone
tools.description: For school-wide sustainability managers: add a campus zone (garden, ground, block, kitchen, toilet block, rooftop, water tank, nursery). Needs confirmation.

tools.name: update_sustainability_zone
tools.description: For school-wide sustainability managers: rename a zone, change its kind or notes, or mark it inactive or active again. Needs confirmation.

tools.name: list_eco_teams
tools.description: For staff: the eco teams (classes, houses, clubs) — every team for school-wide managers, otherwise the teams the caller leads or teaches — with their leads. Read-only.

tools.name: add_eco_team
tools.description: For school-wide sustainability managers: add an eco team — a class (by class name), a house or a club — with its staff leads by name. Needs confirmation.

className.description: For a CLASS team, e.g. "Class 6 A"

tools.name: update_eco_team
tools.description: For school-wide sustainability managers: rename an eco team, replace its staff leads, or mark it inactive or active again. Needs confirmation.

leads.description: The new staff leads, by name

tools.name: list_plants
tools.description: For staff: the trees and plants on record — code, species, zone, who planted them, count, status (alive, needs care, dead, replaced) and the last survival check. Read-only.

tools.name: get_plant
tools.description: For staff: one tree or plant record by its code (TRE-0012) or species, with every survival check. Read-only.

tools.name: list_waste_logs
tools.description: For staff: waste records — stream, weight, day, where it went, vendor and receipt — newest first, optionally by stream and dates. Read-only.

tools.name: list_compost_batches
tools.description: For staff: compost batches — code, zone, started, input and output in kg, status (active, matured, used). Read-only.

tools.name: start_compost_batch
tools.description: For school-wide sustainability managers: start a compost batch on a day, optionally in a zone and with the kg of input. Needs confirmation.

tools.name: update_compost_batch
tools.description: For school-wide sustainability managers: add input (kg) to a compost batch, or move it on to matured (with the output kg) or used. A batch never goes back. Needs confirmation.

tools.name: list_meter_readings
tools.description: For staff: the month-by-month water, electricity, rainwater-harvested and solar figures, with the meter readings where given. Read-only.

tools.name: list_sanitation_duties
tools.description: For staff: sanitation duties — toilet cleaning per block, sanitary-pad dispensers and incinerators, water-tank cleaning — with the next due date, owner, overdue and low-stock flags, and the open task. Read-only.

tools.name: add_sanitation_duty
tools.description: For school-wide sustainability managers: add a sanitation duty (toilet cleaning, pad dispenser, incinerator, water-tank cleaning) for a zone or block, how often, its owner by name and the first due date. Its first occurrence becomes a task for the owner. Needs confirmation.

tools.name: update_sanitation_duty
tools.description: For school-wide sustainability managers: rename a sanitation duty, change its owner or reorder level, or pause or resume it. Needs confirmation.

tools.name: list_sanitation_checks
tools.description: For staff: the checks recorded on a sanitation duty — when, by whom, which checklist items were done, stock after and notes. Read-only.

tools.name: record_sanitation_check
tools.description: Record a check on a sanitation duty the caller owns (any duty for school-wide managers): which checklist items were done (or all of them), stock after a refill, a note (required when an item was not done) and a photo already uploaded to EduOS, given as its link — there is no photo upload in a chat. It closes this occurrence's task and schedules the next. Needs confirmation.

itemsDone.description: The checklist items that were done

photoUrl.description: Link to a photo already uploaded to EduOS (/uploads/...) or an https:// link

tools.name: sync_sanitation_tasks
tools.description: For school-wide sustainability managers: bring the sanitation tasks up to date now — every active duty's current occurrence is announced as a task for its owner, and an occurrence completed from the Tasks screen counts as a check. Needs confirmation.

tools.name: list_evidence_packs
tools.description: For school-wide sustainability managers: the evidence packs EduOS can arrange (Swachh Vidyalaya rating, CSE Green Schools audit, Mission LiFE eco club). EduOS never files anything with these programmes. Read-only.

tools.name: get_evidence_pack
tools.description: For school-wide sustainability managers: one evidence pack for a period (default this academic year) — the school's own figures and evidence files under the programme's headings, with the gaps EduOS has no records for. It supports a coordinator's own submission; EduOS submits nothing. Read-only.

tools.name: draft_newsroom_post
tools.description: Draft a newsroom post (a story, achievement, club update, circle post...) for an audience: everyone signed in, a role, the caller's classes, a circle they belong to, or the public (staff only — parents and students never post outside the school). It stays a draft only the author sees until it is submitted. Photos are added on the Newsroom page, where pictured children's consent is checked. Needs confirmation.

audience.description: PUBLIC (anyone; staff only), INSTITUTION (everyone signed in), CAMPUS, ROLE, CLASS or CIRCLE. Default INSTITUTION

roles.description: For ROLE: role keys, e.g. TEACHER, PARENT

classes.description: For CLASS: class names, e.g. "Class 6 A"

tools.name: get_newsroom_post
tools.description: One newsroom post the caller can see, found by words from its title or text: the full text, audience, reactions and the comments visible to them. Photos of children appear only where their consent allows. Read-only.

post.description: Words from its title or text

tools.name: update_newsroom_post
tools.description: Change the author's own newsroom post — title, text, kind, tags, who may comment. A published post written by someone who cannot publish goes back to review, so an approved story cannot be swapped. Needs confirmation; confirmed on the website.

post.description: Words from its title or text

tools.name: transition_newsroom_post
tools.description: Move the author's own newsroom post along: submit a draft (a moderator's own post is published at once; anyone else's waits for review, and every photo must meet the consent rules first), or withdraw it from every feed (it stays on record). Needs confirmation; confirmed on the website.

post.description: Words from its title or text

tools.name: moderate_newsroom_post
tools.description: For a newsroom moderator (or a circle's own moderator, inside that circle): record their moderation decision on a post — publish a submitted post (photos must meet the consent rules), send it back with a note, take a published post down with the reason, archive it, or pin or unpin it. Reinstating a removed post needs a school moderator and a reason. Recorded only when the moderator states the decision in their own words. Confirmed on the website.

post.description: Words from its title or text

decision.description: the moderator's own decision, as they stated it. Never suggest or assume one.

note.description: Required to send back, take down or reinstate

tools.name: react_to_newsroom_post
tools.description: React to a published newsroom post the caller can see (clap, heart, celebrate, inspired), change the reaction, or remove it. One reaction per person. Needs confirmation.

post.description: Words from its title or text

tools.name: bookmark_newsroom_post
tools.description: Save a published newsroom post to the caller's saved list, or take it off if it is already saved. Needs confirmation.

post.description: Words from its title or text

tools.name: add_newsroom_comment
tools.description: Comment on a published newsroom post the caller can see. Students' comments, and outside adults' comments wherever students can read, wait for a moderator first; some posts take staff replies only or no comments. Needs confirmation; confirmed on the website.

post.description: Words from its title or text

tools.name: list_pending_newsroom_comments
tools.description: For newsroom moderators (and circle moderators, for their circles): comments waiting for review, oldest first, with the post they are on. Read-only.

tools.name: moderate_newsroom_comment
tools.description: For a newsroom moderator (or a circle moderator, in their circle): record their decision on a comment — approve it so others see it, or hide it with the reason. Recorded only when the moderator states the decision in their own words. Confirmed on the website.

comment.description: Words from the comment or the commenter's name

decision.description: the moderator's own decision, as they stated it. Never suggest or assume one.

tools.name: change_my_newsroom_comment
tools.description: Edit the caller's own comment on a newsroom post (it goes through the same moderation as a new one), or delete it. Needs confirmation; confirmed on the website.

comment.description: Words from your comment; default your only comment there

tools.name: report_newsroom_content
tools.description: Report a newsroom post, a comment, a circle or a mentor profile to the moderators (inappropriate, bullying, privacy, consent, spam, other). A consent concern from staff or a pictured child's family hides the photos at once while it is reviewed; consent, privacy and bullying reports also reach the safeguarding officer. A person reviews every report. Needs confirmation; confirmed on the website.

target.description: Words from the post title, the comment, or the circle or mentor name

post.description: For a COMMENT: words from the post it is on

tools.name: list_community_reports
tools.description: For community moderators: open and escalated reports, oldest first — what was reported (with a preview), the reason, who reported it and how many reports the same item has. Read-only.

tools.name: resolve_community_report
tools.description: For a community moderator: record how a report is resolved — actioned (the post comes down, the comment is hidden, the circle archived or the mentor unlisted, unless told not to; other reports on the same item close too), dismissed (held photos come back when no other consent concern is open) or escalated to the safeguarding officer and principal — with the resolution. Recorded only when the moderator states the decision in their own words. Confirmed on the website.

report.description: Words from what was reported, or the reason

decision.description: the moderator's own decision, as they stated it. Never suggest or assume one.

takeDown.description: For ACTIONED: act on the item (default true)

tools.name: draft_event_highlight_post
tools.description: Turn a completed school event into a draft newsroom highlight (its outcome summary and highlights — never an attendee list), addressed to everyone signed in. One highlight per event; it stays a draft until submitted. Needs confirmation.

tools.name: list_community_circles
tools.description: The community circles the caller can see or join (classes, programmes, clubs, projects, interests, careers, alumni, parents): how to join, member count, the caller's own status and whether they moderate it. Members see the member list (outside adults never see the children in it). Read-only.

tools.name: create_community_circle
tools.description: For staff (and alumni, for an alumni circle): start a community circle — its kind, description, how people join (open, approval, invitation), the roles it is for, whether it is adults only, and (staff) whether invited outside adults are welcome in a school circle. The creator is its first moderator. Needs confirmation.

adultsWelcome.description: Staff only: invited parents or alumni may join this school circle

tools.name: join_or_leave_circle
tools.description: Join a community circle (open circles at once; others ask its moderators) or leave one. A circle's last moderator names another before leaving. Needs confirmation.

tools.name: manage_circle_member
tools.description: For a circle's moderator (or a school moderator): invite someone in by name, remove or block a member, or make an active member a moderator (students never moderate; in a school circle only staff do). Only staff invite outside adults into a school circle. Needs confirmation; confirmed on the website.

tools.name: record_circle_join_decision
tools.description: For a circle's moderator: record their decision on a request to join the circle — approve it, or decline it (the request is closed). Recorded only when the moderator states the decision in their own words. Confirmed on the website.

decision.description: the circle moderator's own decision, as they stated it. Never suggest or assume one.

tools.name: list_taggable_students
tools.description: For staff writing a newsroom post: students they may tag in a photo (a teacher, their own classes), by name or admission number, with each child's current media consent (none, inside the school, public). Read-only.

search.description: At least two letters of a name or admission number

tools.name: get_my_children_media_consent
tools.description: A parent's children's (or an adult student's own) current media consent: none, inside the school only, or public. Read-only.

tools.name: set_child_media_consent
tools.description: For a parent: set their own child's media consent — none, inside the school only, or public (an adult student in a college sets their own). Withdrawing consent hides the child's photos at once, even in posts already published. Needs confirmation.

child.description: Your child's name; default your only child

tools.name: record_media_consent_form
tools.description: For community moderators: record a child's media consent from a signed paper form — none, inside the school, or public — citing the form's reference (an uploaded copy may be linked). It replaces the earlier consent. Confirmed on the website.

evidenceFileUrl.description: Link to the uploaded signed form (/uploads/...)

tools.name: list_mentors
tools.description: Verified mentors who opted in — alumni, senior students and staff — with their headline, topics and availability (no contact details). Moderators may include unverified profiles. Read-only.

tools.name: update_my_mentor_profile
tools.description: The caller's own mentor profile: headline, batch, topics, availability, and whether they are listed. A changed headline, batch or topics needs verifying again by a moderator before the profile is shown. Needs confirmation.

listed.description: Show me as a mentor (default true)

tools.name: verify_mentor_profile
tools.description: For community moderators, at their explicit request: verify a mentor's stated affiliation (their batch, headline and topics) so the profile is shown to mentees. Confirmed on the website.

tools.name: list_my_mentoring
tools.description: The caller's mentoring requests as mentor, mentee or supervisor (moderators also see every supervised request): topic, status, people, sessions and feedback. Read-only.

tools.name: request_mentoring
tools.description: Ask a verified mentor for mentoring on a topic. A request involving a student is supervised: sessions are group or staff-supervised, arranged by the school, and contact details are refused. Needs confirmation.

tools.name: record_mentoring_request_decision
tools.description: For a mentor: record their answer to a mentoring request addressed to them — accept or decline. Recorded only when the mentor states the decision in their own words. Confirmed on the website.

request.description: The mentee's name or the topic

decision.description: the mentor's own decision, as they stated it. Never suggest or assume one.

tools.name: manage_mentoring
tools.description: Move a mentoring request along: a school moderator takes it on as supervisor (supervised requests); the mentor or supervisor schedules a session (date, time, mode — sessions with students are group or supervised — and an https link); either side completes it (with feedback and a 1-5 rating) or cancels it. Needs confirmation; confirmed on the website.

request.description: The other person's name or the topic

tools.name: get_my_student_profile_links
tools.description: A student's own (or a parent's children's) social links on the student profile — LinkedIn, Instagram, GitHub, a personal site — with who has agreed to share them: other students and parents see them only when the student (and, for a minor, a guardian) agree. Read-only.

tools.name: get_student_profile_links
tools.description: A student's social profile links. Others see them only when the student (and, for a minor, a guardian) agreed; the student, their guardians and staff see the links and the consent state. Read-only.

studentName.description: Full or partial name; an ambiguous match is refused, never guessed

tools.name: set_student_profile_links
tools.description: For a student (their own) or a parent (their child's): set the social links on the student profile (https LinkedIn, Instagram, GitHub or personal site), and give or take back the student's own agreement to share (student) or the guardian's agreement (parent). New links from a student need the guardian's agreement again. Needs confirmation.

child.description: For a parent: the child's name

guardianConsent.description: Parent only: I agree to my child's links being shared

tools.name: moderate_alumni_post
tools.description: For alumni managers: record their decision on a post in an alumni circle — publish one waiting for review, reject it, or take a published one down (rejecting and taking down need a reason for the author). Recorded only when the manager states the decision in their own words. Confirmed on the website.

post.description: Words from its title or text

decision.description: the alumni manager's own decision, as they stated it. Never suggest or assume one.

tools.name: list_alumni_circle_posts
