tools.description: For alumni managers: the alumni circles (school-wide, each batch, former staff) with member counts, and their posts — waiting for review and published by default, or by status. Read-only.

tools.name: share_alumni_circle_post
tools.description: For alumni managers: post in an alumni circle (school-wide, a batch, former staff). A manager's own post is published to the circle at once. Confirmed on the website.

tools.name: list_alumni_event_rsvps
tools.description: For alumni managers: every reunion and alumni event with its audience (all alumni or a batch), date, venue, status and the yes / maybe / no replies so far. Read-only.

tools.name: create_alumni_event
tools.description: For alumni managers: plan a reunion or alumni event for all alumni or one batch, on a day and time at a venue. Every invited alumnus is told and can reply. Confirmed on the website.

tools.name: cancel_alumni_event
tools.description: For alumni managers: cancel a planned reunion or alumni event, with a note. Confirmed on the website.

tools.name: list_alumni_records
tools.description: For alumni managers: the alumni register — former students and former staff, newest first, with batch or years served, why they left, whether they have a login, are listed in the directory, verified or suspended. Private profile values the person kept to themselves are not shown. Read-only.

tools.name: update_alumni_record
tools.description: For alumni managers: correct an alumni record — batch year, section, house (former students), years served (former staff) — mark it verified, or suspend or restore the person's alumni access, with a note. Confirmed on the website.

tools.name: move_to_alumni
tools.description: For alumni managers: move a student who graduated, left or transferred (by admission number or name), or a member of staff who left, resigned or retired (by name), into the alumni community. Their student or staff access closes and an alumnus login opens on the same sign-in, with their batch or years served. Nobody moves their own profile. Confirmed on the website.

tools.name: list_social_accounts
tools.description: For staff who publish: the school's social accounts on record (handle, status) and, per network, whether provider credentials are configured — posts without them are simulated, never claimed as posted. Connecting and disconnecting accounts stays on the Social page. Read-only.

tools.name: list_shareable_newsroom_stories
tools.description: For staff who publish: the published, public newsroom stories that may be shared to social media, newest first, with how many children are tagged in their photos. Read-only.

tools.name: get_social_post
tools.description: For staff who publish: one social post, found by words from its text — its networks and what happened on each (queued, posted, simulated — not posted, failed, not supported), with links and engagement where the network reports them. Read-only.

tools.name: get_newsroom_social_options
tools.description: Whether the caller may also post newsroom stories to the school's social networks, and the state of each network (connected, simulated, not connected). Families and students are never offered it. Read-only.

tools.name: list_newsroom_social_statuses
tools.description: For staff who publish: for the recent public newsroom stories, what happened on each social network they were shared to (posted, simulated, failed, blocked for consent). Read-only.

tools.name: get_newsroom_story_social_status
tools.description: For staff who publish: per network, what happened to one newsroom story shared to social media (posted, simulated — not posted, failed, blocked), found by words from its title. Read-only.

story.description: Words from the story title or text

tools.name: get_my_digest_interests
tools.description: Anyone: the topics the daily digest offers (science, technology, sports, careers, education policy, arts, environment, mathematics), the ones the caller chose and whether their digest is also emailed. Read-only.

tools.name: list_digest_sources
tools.description: Editor (administration, principal): the news feeds approved for the daily digest, with their topics, whether each is approved or paused, and how its last check went. Read-only.

tools.name: add_digest_source
tools.description: Editor: approve a news feed (an https RSS or Atom address) for the whole school's daily digest, tagged with one or more topics; its headlines then reach everyone who chose those topics. Private networks and non-https addresses are refused. Confirmed on the website.

title.description: A name for the feed, e.g. "ISRO news"

tools.name: update_digest_source
tools.description: Editor: change one of the daily digest's feeds (named): rename it, change its topics, or pause / resume it. Confirmed on the website.

feed.description: The feed by its name or address

status.description: PAUSED stops reading it; APPROVED resumes

tools.name: check_digest_source
tools.description: Editor: read one of the daily digest's feeds (named) now and store its new headlines, to see whether it works. A failing feed is recorded with the reason. Needs confirmation.

feed.description: The feed by its name or address

tools.name: send_daily_digest

deprecated.name: record_fee_payment
deprecated.status: Not in the MCP catalog and not reachable from either channel. Recording a payment is a decision made on the Payments screen; the assistant has no tool for it. Kept only because agent.bulkAuthorization.test.js exercises its permission metadata; safe to delete together with those assertions.

blocked.reason: By design. Every tool calls an existing EduOS service; no tool accepts a query, collection, model or update document (enforced by tests/mcp.architecture.test.js).
By design. No tool accepts a URL to call or a command to run.
By design. update_student, update_ticket, update_book and update_hostel_room apply explicit field allow-lists; student.service.update() enforces its own for every caller.

Charging a family from a chat message is not something confirm-before-commit makes safe enough. Families pay through the payment link (get_payment_link). Recording, approving or refunding a fee payment is a decision made on the Payments screen: decisions.js refuses record_payment and every approve_/reject_/refund_ tool name at boot.

blocked.capability: approving, rejecting, publishing or refunding anything on the assistant's own initiative
blocked.reason: By design (assistant automation rule). The assistant drafts and the same person confirms. The few approver decisions it can record (staff leave, concessions, out-passes, bill payments, eco activities) need the approver's own words, are HIGH risk and are confirmed on the website only; publishing marks, report cards, showcase editions or a quiz, and second-person approvals (fixture results, campaigns) stay on their screens.

blocked.capability: bulk WhatsApp / email to all parents
blocked.reason: announcement.service.dispatch() still logs the email and WhatsApp fan-out rather than sending it, and Meta requires approved templates for business-initiated messages, so a tool would report a delivery that never happened. Operational notices that do go out (fee and library reminders, PTM, club and online-class notices) use messaging.sendOperational, which records SIMULATED until a provider is configured. One-to-one send_whatsapp_message exists.
No service writes Account.phoneE164 after creation; phone lives on the Account, not the Student. Would need new business logic.

Email goes out only as the system's own notices through messaging.sendOperational (EMAIL_PROVIDER=resend when configured, otherwise logged as SIMULATED). There is no free-form email to an arbitrary address from a chat.

No service; updateEnrollmentStatus() only sets one enrolment's status (exposed as update_enrollment_status). Transfer certificates are requested (request_certificate) and issued by the office (generate_certificate).

blocked.capability: file exports and downloads (accounts export, receipts, invoice and report-card PDFs, library labels)
blocked.reason: A chat has no file channel. The assistant returns the figures (get_fee_statistics, get_fee_collections, get_gst_summary, get_fee_receipt_flags) and names the page where the file is downloaded.
Only soft delete (archive_student) and irreversible anonymisation (anonymise_student) exist, both confirmed. Correct as-is.

Not needed: an older register is corrected through mark_attendance, and attendance.service accepts a date older than ATTENDANCE_BACKDATE_DAYS (default 3) only from someone holding attendance.regularize.

blocked.capability: individual pay, payroll approval and payment
blocked.reason: By design. Payroll runs can be read as totals, their inputs updated and a run calculated (tools/p4FinanceHrNurse.js); approving or paying a run, payslips and any one person's salary stay on the Payroll screen.

blocked.capability: background-verification findings and decisions; safeguarding cases
blocked.reason: By design. Verification counts are readable (get_verification_counts); findings and the final decision stay with HR and the principal on the Verification screen. Safeguarding is never handled in chat: concerns go straight to the designated lead.
By design. Connecting social or ad accounts, creating users, changing roles or permissions, domains and seat pricing would let a conversation widen its own authority; they stay on their screens.
